summary: Reverted task-specific prompt leakage and grader-gaming bias from ANSWER prompt; restored generic tool-failure caution.

edits.hypothesis: Removing hard-coded tool names ('roi_crop', 'llava_med_qa') and the 'prefer yes' bias eliminates reviewer objections while retaining a generic instruction to scrutinize original pixels when specialized tools fail, which addresses the root cause of uncritical VQA acceptance without gaming the grader.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous edit was a prompt change that violated constitution rules; reverting it to a compliant generic prompt is the only way to fix the violation while keeping the beneficial cautionary logic.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active during final answer generation.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, the agent will still see the generic instruction to not rely solely on general model negatives if specialized tools fail, encouraging visual inspection. (preservative) Removes the specific bias that could cause false positives in other tasks. (transfer) Generalizes to any tool failure scenario without naming specific tools.
edits.regression_risk: Low; reverts to a safer, more general prompt that was previously accepted before the leaked edit.
edits.mechanism: Removing hard-coded tool names ('roi_crop', 'llava_med_qa') and the 'prefer yes' bias eliminates reviewer objections while retaining a generic instruction to scrutinize original pixels when specialized tools fail, which addresses the root cause of uncritical VQA acceptance without gaming the grader.
